notes: URLs and SHA256 values are populated after the first Zenodo deposition.

masked_t2t_hla_minimap2.description: minimap2 index of T2T-CHM13v2.0 + IPD-IMGT/HLA, masked against UHGG bacterial and RefSeq viral pan-genomes.

masked_t2t_hla_bowtie2.description: bowtie2 index of the masked T2T-CHM13v2.0 + IPD-IMGT/HLA reference (6 .bt2 files in a tar).

kraken2_gdpr_compact.description: Compact Kraken2 database covering human, great apes, mouse, and rat for GDPR-pass scrubbing.

aux_refs.description: Auxiliary k-mer references: human rRNA (Ensembl 113), mtDNA, low-copy repeats, transcript decoys.

human_kmer_set.description: Human-specific 27-mer set for GDPR belt-and-braces bbduk scrub (orthogonal to Kraken2).
